name: Database Security & Configuration Auditor
description: Read-only database security configuration and privilege auditor for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB. Evaluates mandatory TLS enforcement, excessive superuser privileges, public network exposure, default administrative accounts, and audit logging.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

audit_tls_enforcement.description: Verify that database refuses unencrypted client connections

audit_superuser_accounts.description: Identify non-administrative accounts possessing SUPERUSER or GRANT OPTION privileges

audit_network_listening.description: Check if database listens on 0.0.0.0 without IP allowlists
